title: S149 later notes: Questions footer, hint polish, pane scroll keys

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S149 relay (run-20261026-162203-0595, landed fff74f2), not fixed in that slice.
Owner decisions (2026-10-26, session a2bf7e0e): drop the Questions list's body footer "[enter] open" (`internal/tui/questions.go:146`, docs/dashboard.md:782) to match Decisions; on Waves with nothing ticked the hint keeps not showing l (accepted).
Other notes:
- Lineup budget rows lost the "type a whole number" hint; add it for row 2 and up.
- Should "q quit" never drop on the main views, as "? help" no longer does?
- Remove "?help" from the sidebar header now that the hint shows it.
- Style the Questions tab count; give the read-only note on the ledger pane its own style.
- Wire ctrl+d/u and their hints to the decision, roadmap-item and waves-item panes; S151 should reuse pane.room.
- Add a help note that ctrl+u clears a field.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first for the Questions footer drop and the pane scroll keys; triage the rest. UI slice: UI pass per rule u10.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
